verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests the panel-mounted power-button connector and defines its connection and control behavior.
The freelancer raises a material unresolved space constraint for the newly requested connector on the power board.
The client relocates the connector to the main board and specifies its new PWRON connection; updated keys replace prior values without requiring attribute deletion.
Relocating the connector resolves the power-board space uncertainty and returns the requirement to active execution.
The generic placement approval does not unambiguously identify the panel power connector and does not support the asserted board or signal-connection values.
